_note: Single source of truth for site-wide values and the page manifest. The nav link list itself lives in exactly one place: partials/header.html. Run `node build.js` after editing anything here or in partials/ or src/.
_siteUrl: TODO — set the production origin (e.g. https://boundlessgracia.org/) to emit absolute <link rel=canonical> and absolute sitemap URLs. While empty the build emits document-relative canonicals, which are valid but weak for SEO.
_donateUrl: TODO — DECISION NEEDED. content.json gives the canonical donation endpoint as https://donate.boundlessgracia.org/give, but that host does not resolve in DNS. Every donate CTA is routed to the internal donate.html page until a working endpoint is confirmed. Change this one value to switch the whole site over; ?fund= params are appended per-CTA via donateFunds below.
_donateFunds: Only appended when donateUrl points at a real donation endpoint. While donateUrl is the internal page these are dropped, because donate.html has no fund routing.
_social: TODO — BGCF's real profile URLs are unknown. content.json site.social lists all five as "#". Per instruction, no URLs are invented: a null here omits that icon from the header and footer entirely rather than emitting href="#", which is an accessibility and SEO defect. Fill any value in and its icon reappears in both places automatically.

pages.title: Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation — Empowering Children. Transforming Lives
pages.description: BGCF is a non-profit, non-partisan child-focused organisation in Kyegegwa District, Uganda, working with orphaned and vulnerable children through health, education and livelihoods.

pages.title: We Heal — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: We Heal — BGCF's health, nutrition and WASH programme: community outreaches, malnutrition screening, immunisation and maternal referral, safe water and hygiene.

pages.description: We Educate — BGCF's education and child development programme: sponsorship, scholastic materials, early childhood and remedial learning, vocational training and mentorship.

pages.title: We Empower — Boundless Gracia Children's Foundation
pages.description: We Empower — BGCF's livelihoods and protection programme: village savings groups, enterprise and financial literacy training, start-up grants and climate-smart agriculture.
